title: Null control: lithium crossref pubs vs INDA
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Null control: Crossref lithium weekly pubs 20d z-score > 1 should NOT lead INDA returns by 1-5 days (-); if it matches the hormuz result the crossref->INDA channel is noise; trade short INDA 5d [research.lithium.crossref_pubs -> finance.INDA.log_return] (parent: R2-0087)
message: Null control holds: lithium crossref pubs do not lead INDA (r=0.04, perm_p=0.98, validity 0); crossref->INDA channel is noise; the n=7 short-INDA rule (act 8.29) is a small-sample artifact, not tradeable.

trade_idea.entry_rule: research.lithium.crossref_pubs rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short INDA next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
